# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- ADR 0011 (docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md, Accepted, mira-app dda0e11): CSV only; no XLSX until superseded. Not superseded as of 2026-10-22.
- 2026-10-22 Mira said: "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." This does not name XLSX or lift ADR 0011, so nothing was added; the export stays CSV (`keep_as_is`).
- Open: ask Mira whether she wants to supersede ADR 0011 for XLSX. If yes, her words are needed for a new ADR. A new dependency would also need an MIT/Apache-2.0 licence (mira-decisions ADR 0020).
- Open (unconfirmed guess): the accountant's spreadsheet tool may already open the CSV, so check with Haruto what fails.
